display.text:
# Context Pack: `shared-usecase-vocabulary` — Cross-interface operation vocabulary and parity

Target: ultraplan-go @ 8eef70f4903b25580719960009a170945bdad9ad (frozen).
Planning context: ultraplan-workspace @ ab12dc38059c9bf485f9aced9075bcd7d924cac5.
Domain: operator-interfaces. Risk: high. Descriptive only — no defect judgments.

## 1. Purpose

The convergence fabric behind CLI, TUI, and web: one typed operation vocabulary (`OperationKind`, 27 constants), one prepare→confirm→accept→run pipeline (`PrepareOperation`/`RunOperation` plus the optional `DurableOperationManager`), one shared runtime-backed executor (`sharedOperationRunner`), and one durable landing format (run-control rows whose `Target.Operation` stores the kind string; dedup keys stored in the `operation_aliases` table and `confirmation_digest` column). Three structurally different acceptance-digest regimes (web session+token hash, TUI content hash, CLI empty) feed the same alias column. Cancellation reasons and cancel-time target checks differ per door before converging on `RequestCancellation`. Read-only composition is split: web composes `readOnly=true`, TUI leaves it false. Durable-event replay/polling exists as three structurally similar Go loops plus an SSE/in-memory replay pair.

## 2. Entrypoints and control flow

### 2.1 Vocabulary core (`internal/app/operations.go`)
- `OperationKind` constants :74-102 (27): `validate`, `sprint-status`, `sprint-prompt`, `sprint-flow-dry-run`, `sprint-flow`, `sprint-stage-dry-run`, `sprint-stage`, `execute-status`, `execute-dry-run`, `execute-start`, `execute-resume`, `review-status`, `review-dry-run`, `review-start`, `smoke-status`, `smoke-dry-run`, `smoke-start`, `verify-dry-run`, `verify-start`, `qa-status`, `qa-dry-run`, `qa-start`, `qa-resume`, `qa-recover`, `study-start`, `study-resume`, `study-cancel`.
- `OperationState` :104-113: preparing/running/complete/failed/cancelled/partial.
- Capability interfaces: `ReadOnlyUseCases` (Dashboard, PreviewArtifact; usecases.go:24-27), `WebOperations` (Validate/PrepareOperation/RunOperation; operations.go:32-36), union `OperationalUseCases` :25-28 consumed by the TUI, optional `DurableOperationManager` :41-45 (AcceptOperation/RecordOperationEvent/FinishOperation returning `AcceptedOperation{RunID, Context, Existing, Lifecycle}`), optional `OperationCleanupRecorder` :57-59 and `OperationReconciler` :68-70 (web drain/recovery), `RunUseCases` (Runs/Run/RunEvents/CancelRun/RunHealth; run_usecases.go:29-35). `dashboardUseCases` (usecases.go:61-71) carries root, runner func, stageRuntime, reviewConcurrency, smoke/qa settings, `readOnly`, runs, durable.

### 2.2 Prepare (`dashboardUseCases.PrepareOperation`, operations.go:211-358)
Strips caller-supplied `ExpectedFingerprint` (:215, server authority per comment :129-132), normalizes fields/lists (:523-539, lists trimmed/deduped/sorted :559-575), validates scope identifiers ([A-Za-z0-9._-], ≤128, no `/\\`, not `.`/`..`; :541-557) and QA field lockdown (project/sprint/map-owned shard only; :361-374). Review start/dry-run default Parallelism from configured review concurrency (:223-225). Per-kind Confirmation population (:227-319): runtime-free classes get warning text; QA dry-run/start/resume call `QAMap` and admit only map-owned shards; sprint-status is declared mutating ("MAY REFRESH FLOW-STATE.JSON"); smoke dry-run/start run a real `RunSmoke(DryRun:true)` preview to fill scope/prereqs/timeout source. Paths + web refresh hints (:320-331), `MutationClass` ∈ read_only/sprint_mutation/study_mutation (:332-340), `ModelSource` via stage-runtime lookup (:341-343, 603-625), prerequisites (:586-601). Canonical form = `json.Marshal(req)` with fingerprint field cleared (:577-584); fingerprint basis = canonical + `\nruntime=` ModelSource + `\nscope=` joined Scope (:351); `InputFingerprint` = sha256 over governed-input files (`governedOperationInputs` :627-661 — ultraplan.yml, project/sprint artifacts, QA adds execute/review/run-state/flow-state; studies add study.yml/yaml/run-state; missing entries skipped, symlinks rejected incl. inside dir walks, sorted walk order; :663-718).

### 2.3 Run dispatch (`dashboardUseCases.RunOperation`, operations.go:376-521)
Clears expected, re-prepares fresh (:377-386); non-empty expected ≠ fresh fingerprint → `ErrStaleOperation` (:383-385, sentinel :209). Emits running event; in-process switch handles runtime-free kinds (validate, sprint-status, prompt, flow/stage/execute dry-runs and status, review status/dry-run, smoke status/dry-run, qa status/dry-run/recover, verify dry-run) against sprint/study/project services; all other kinds delegate to `u.runner` (nil → "runtime-backed operation is unavailable without configured composition" :513-517). Terminal complete event emitted :519.

### 2.4 Shared runtime executor (`sharedOperationRunner`, operation_runner.go:18-168)
Single implementation wired into both serve (serve_commands.go:79) and tui (tui_commands.go:53). Maps: OperationStage/Flow → FlowStage/runSprintFlow with model override plumbing (`stageFlowRequest` :175-188); ExecuteStart/Resume → Execute(TaskID, ModelOverride, Resume); ReviewStart → Review(Concurrency/Focus/Restart/ModelOverride, progress events); SmokeStart → RunSmoke with parsed timeout (parse errors silently yield 0) and post-hoc artifact preview; VerifyStart → Verify; QAStart/QAResume → extracts writer token+fence from the durable operation context value (`qaOwnershipFromContext`, durable_operations.go:140-156) and applies `WithQAWriterFence`; StudyStart/StudyResume → runLoopService + RunLoop with parallelism/model and stats-rich progress events (`applyRuntimeObservation` operations.go:163-194 merges provider/tool observations); StudyCancel → ListStudy + `study.CancelRunLoop` (SIGINT to lock-PID lane, message reports PID :152-162). All failures route through `failedOperation`.

### 2.5 Error taxonomy (`failedOperation`, operations.go:751-810)
context.Canceled → cancelled state; smoke errors → code/category/guidance from AsSmokeError; QA errors → `qa.<category>` with category remap (runtime unavailable/persistence→runtime, conflict→concurrency, else validation); flow-state/run-state malformed/unsupported, project/sprint RefError, or any findings → validation.reference; verification conflict or ErrStaleOperation → workflow.locked/concurrency; default internal.error. Retryable = runtime/process/timeout/concurrency categories. Cause strings pass `displaySafe` (redaction + ANSI/control strip, usecases.go:251-278).

### 2.6 Acceptance digest regimes (three doors, one alias column)
- **Web**: prepare issues a `preparationStore` record bound to (session, CanonicalRequest, InputFingerprint) with 2-min TTL, ≤128 records, typed replay/expiry/mismatch/stale errors (security.go:368-446). Start re-prepares then consumes the token inside the hub callback; dedup key = sha256(session+"\x00"+confirmationToken) hex (security.go:448-451); `startConfirmed` checks in-memory `h.dedup` first (same-session only; stale mapping deleted), enforces draining/capacity, then calls `AcceptOperation(ctx, prepared, dedupKey)` (operations.go:150-218). Alias hit returns doc {ID=existing run id, State=accepted.Lifecycle, RefreshPath=/runs/<id>} without starting work (:193-198). If the use cases lack the durable capability (`ErrWebUnavailable`) the hub proceeds in-memory only.
- **TUI**: digest = hex(sha256(CanonicalRequest + "\x00" + InputFingerprint)) computed in `beginOperation` when a Confirmation exists and use cases implement the manager (internal/tui/app.go:232-254); Existing renders non-running result "matching durable operation already exists".
- **CLI**: `beginDurableCLICommand` wraps runtime-backed commands (flow, verify, execute, review, smoke, qa start/resume, study start/resume/task-analysis/task-synthesis) with `AcceptOperation(ctx, Confirmation{Request: request}, "")` — empty digest, so no alias row and no dedup (durable_operations.go:49-60; inventory pinned by run_control_inventory_test.go). The wrapper keeps the manager alive for the command and provides Context() and QAWriterToken(); Finish maps ctx.Err()/error → complete/cancelled/failed with 30 s timeout (durable_operations.go:62-91).
- **Landing**: all three converge on `repository.Accept(Acceptance{Target:{Kind:"operation", Operation:string(kind), Project, Sprint, Study, Stage, Task}, ProductStatus:"prepared", OperationAlias:digest, ConfirmationDigest:digest})` (durable_operations.go:97-115). SQLite persists target_kind/operation_kind/project_id/sprint_id/study_id/stage_id/task_id + confirmation_digest on the runs row and inserts an `operation_aliases(alias_id, run_id, alias_kind='operation')` row only when the digest is non-empty; alias conflicts surface as CodeConflict "operation alias already exists"; values bounded by MaxSafeValueBytes, control chars rejected (sqlite.go:402-455). `ResolveOperationAlias` maps alias→Snapshot (:472-484). Accept also enforces soft-quota compaction/refusal (:380-395). After accept: Claim with OwnerLeaseDuration, lifecycle-running event (failure proposes persistence_lost terminal), ownership {repository, fence} into the operation context, control goroutine started (durable_operations.go:116-137).

### 2.7 Composition roots
- **serve** (serve_commands.go:18-99): builds a local `dashboardUseCases` with `readOnly: true` (:56-61) used for the runner; `NewWebUseCases` internally builds another dashboard copy hardcoding `readOnly: true` (web_usecases.go:420-441); both share `sharedOperationRunner`, `repositoryRunUseCases`, `newDurableOperationManager(repository, deps.runControl.owner)`; WebRunner receives ServeRunOptions (surfaces.go:10-20). Listen must be numeric loopback (:117-139).
- **tui** (tui_commands.go:21-61): single `dashboardUseCases` without readOnly (false), same runs/durable/runner wiring; TUIRunner handoff.
- **CLI runtime-backed commands**: direct service invocation guarded by beginDurableCLICommand (sprint_commands.go:237-550 six sites; study_commands.go:211-852 four sites).
- main wiring: app.Run builds dependencies incl. runControlState (one repository handle per workspace, startup Reconcile; run_control.go:22-95) and dispatches tui/serve (app.go:88-178).

### 2.8 Web-only vocabulary projection (internal/web)
- Kind mapping `mapOperationRequest` (operation_handlers.go:610-742): underscores normalized to dashes; legacy aliases accepted (`validation`, `prompt-preview`, `dry-run`, `execute`, `review`, `smoke`, `verify`, `study-run-loop`; action/dry_run/resume flags fold into distinct kinds); scope rules: validate requires XOR project/study; study-* requires only study; others require project+sprint; QA option lockdown duplicated at the transport layer (:733-740) mirroring app-layer validateQAOperationRequest.
- Operation lifecycle document states: accepted/running/cancelling/succeeded/failed/cancelled/interrupted/cleanup_uncertain; terminal classification helper (operations.go:616-623); stable SSE names snapshot/progress/warning/finding/artifact/cancel_requested/recovery_required/terminal with unknown producer names folded to "progress" (:470-477); error envelope compatibility table (status/code/message/retryable; writeOperationError :788-828).
- Hub capacity/bounds (operations.go:18-32): 8 active ops, 128 preparations, 2-min TTL, 256 events & 256 KiB per op, 16 KiB max encoded event (oversize → warning substitution), 8 subscribers/op, 32 streams, 10-min terminal retention with reap, 15 s heartbeat, 30-min stream lifetime; slow subscriber dropped and counted.
- Drain: cancels every non-terminal owned record with reason server_shutdown, waits done; deadline overrun persists `RecordOperationCleanupUncertain` into sprint/study product storage (web_usecases.go:540-561) and projects cleanup_uncertain terminals (:479-557). `ReconcileOperations` walks all sprints (ReconcileInterruptedMutation) and studies (ReconcileInterruptedRun) (:563-591).
- Session ownership: status/events scoped to session; active-operations list merges hub records with a run-control page of TargetKind=operation lifecycles accepted/queued/running/cancelling (operation_handlers.go:185-204); durable fallback status/events projections require Target.Kind=="operation" (:364, 416, 452).

### 2.9 Shared dashboard projections (all doors)
ProjectSummaries (project_usecases.go:25+), StudySummaries (study_usecases.go:74-157: planned-task preview via NewRunState with RunID "tui-preview", LoadRunState + in-memory ReconcileRunState, SummarizeRetries, lock-liveness via RunLoopActive, >2 m staleness flag, attempt history/fallback derivation), SprintSummaries (sprint_usecases.go:363-532: per-sprint Status + QAStatus + PrepareReview coverage join + nine-stage validateSprintStage loop; failure path emits bounded substitute summary with qa.invalid_state blocker; RefreshMayWrite=!readOnly disclosure fields :389-390/:455-456), QA projections (QAMap/QAStatus/QAShard/Theory/Synthesis/RunQA/ResumeQA/CancelQA/RecoverQA with displaySafe redaction throughout; theories capped at 24; shards capped at MaximumQABudgets.TotalShards; withQAConformanceReview always reads through WithoutStatusWrites() :747-758). Runs/Run/RunEvents/CancelRun/RunHealth delegate to repositoryRunUseCases, ErrWebUnavailable when absent (usecases.go:73-120).

## 3. Inputs / outputs

Inputs: transport requests (browser JSON/form specs, TUI keystroke-built OperationRequests, CLI positional args/flags) mapped into `OperationRequest`; workspace governed files (hash inputs, dashboards); effective config (stage runtimes, DefaultParallel, smoke/QA settings); run-control DB queries; wall clock. Outputs: Confirmation DTOs (scope/warning/mutation class/fingerprints/web refresh path); OperationResults (state/subject/message/content≤32 KiB/findings/error taxonomy); OperationEvents streamed per door (in-process channels for TUI; journal + SSE for web; stderr text for CLI); durable rows (runs, operation_aliases, events, terminals, cancellation states); QA writer tokens/fences; SIGINT to foreign study run-loop PID. Browser-facing vocabulary additionally includes the frozen SSE name set, lifecycle state strings, and error codes enumerated in §2.8.

## 4. Authoritative state

Durable authority is run-control (spine surface): runs row columns incl. target_kind, operation_kind (= OperationKind string), confirmation_digest; operation_aliases table (alias_kind='operation'); cancellation_state/reason; lifecycle/liveness/record_state/retention. This surface owns none of it directly but defines everything written there from interactive doors: Target shape built in durable_operations.go:98-102; alias/digest values from §2.6; cancellation reasons from §5. Product-side side-state touched through the vocabulary: QA cleanup-uncertainty records (RecordCleanupUncertain into sprint/study storage), flow-state.json status subrecords rewritten by Status when not readOnly. Ephemeral: web hub records/preparations/dedup map (process-lifetime, reaped), TUI model operation state.

## 5. Cancellation semantics (per-door divergence)

All doors end in `RequestCancellation(runID, reason)` (lifecycle.go:70-134: reason required non-empty, ≤MaxSafeValueBytes, no control chars; idempotent no-op when terminal or already cancelling; CAS on last_sequence; appends cancellation event; lifecycle→cancelling; owner acknowledges within tick cadence).
Reason vocabularies actually sent:
- Browser hub path: canonicalCancelReason folds arbitrary input to {server_shutdown, timeout, recovery, else user_request} (operations.go:625-632); handlers pass literal "user_request" (operation_handlers.go:207, 390); drain passes "server_shutdown" (:490). Note spelling differs from the CLI/TUI family ("user_request" vs "user_requested").
- Browser durable fallback + TUI: "user_requested" (operation_handlers.go:209, 392; tui/app.go:110, 124).
- CancelQA use case: "read-only QA cancellation requested" (sprint_usecases.go:731), gated by membership check: snapshot Target.Project/Sprint must equal request and Target.Operation ∈ {qa-start, qa-resume}, else "QA run does not belong to the selected sprint" (:716-737).
- CLI `run cancel --reason`: validated against {user_requested, operator_requested, shutdown_requested, quota_exceeded}, default user_requested (run_commands.go:201-216, 394-401).
Target-check divergence: hub cancelOperation checks only session ownership (empty-session callers may cancel any record; used intentionally by drain, operations.go:350); durable fallback/status require Target.Kind=="operation"; CancelQA adds project/sprint/operation membership; TUI cancels ActiveRunID or the open RouteRun ID with no target-kind recheck; CLI run cancel accepts any well-formed run id. Study-cancel is not a RequestCancellation at all: it becomes OperationStudyCancel → SIGINT to the PID recorded by the study lock.

## 6. Replay / polling logic (parallel implementations)

Same durable-replay semantics implemented independently:
1. CLI `run follow`: Events(after,512)+Snapshot loop; exits when terminal ∧ after≥LastSequence; waits 250 ms catching up else 1 s idle (run_commands.go:131-195).
2. Web durable SSE fallback `followDurableOperationEvents`: identical shape (Events(after,512)/Snapshot/terminal check/wait 1 s|250 ms) projecting durable events to stable SSE names (operation_handlers.go:447-514).
3. TUI run-detail refresh: on every load/refresh/1 Hz tick fetches page (limit 200) and, when the route is a run detail, Snapshot then RunEvents(after = OldestRetainedSequence−1, limit 200) (tui/app.go:360-390).
Adjacent but distinct mechanisms sharing the conventions: REST/SSE run events endpoint with cursor_ahead/replay_gap conflicts (Last-Event-ID vs after exclusivity; run_handlers.go:930-990+) and the same OldestRetainedSequence−1 start convention (run_handlers.go:337-338); in-memory hub subscribe replay with recovery_required+snapshot synthesis on gap (operations.go:376-426); browser static/js/sse.js Last-Event-ID reconnect pinned by contract test.

## 7. Trust boundaries

- Same logical action arriving via different doors must produce equivalent durable semantics (assignment framing): kind string, Target fields, and lifecycle writes are shared; identity entering the alias differs by design — web binds to (session, token) [per-browser anti-double-submit], TUI binds to content (canonical+fingerprint), CLI binds to nothing (every invocation its own run).
- Caller-supplied ExpectedFingerprint is stripped twice (prepare entry :215; RunOperation :377-378) and re-issued server-side; stale detection compares fresh fingerprint after re-hash of governed inputs.
- Identifier admission is layered: transport-level validOptionalIdentifier (web), validateOperationScope ([A-Za-z0-9._-] etc.), QA field lockdown enforced at both transport (mapOperationRequest) and app (validateQAOperationRequest) layers.
- Fingerprinting rejects symlinks anywhere in governed inputs and hashes with relative-path separators; missing files skipped (TOCTOU between hashing and execution is inherent to the mechanism).
- Sanitization boundary into durable/display data: displaySafe (app) for findings/errors/projections; payload whitelisting/bounding in RecordOperationEvent (durable_operations.go:182-195) and runtimeEventDraft (run_control.go:417-545, sensitive-key denylist, 30-key cap, bounded values); safeWebText redaction for web projections; safe command/event-name allowlists.
- Cancellation authority: repository validates reason format only; membership/ownership semantics are per-door policy (§5).
- Hub session model: signed cookie session + CSRF for API mutations; empty-session bypass exists for internal drain only.

## 8. External effects & retry/restart/error semantics

Effects per accepted operation: run rows/aliases/events/terminals/cancellation records; product mutations only via sharedOperationRunner services (workspace artifacts, review/smoke/QA trees, git publication inside those surfaces); SIGINT lane for study-cancel; cleanup-uncertainty records on web shutdown deadline overrun. Retry: web door has explicit idempotent replay (same session+token returns original operation; local dedup map + durable alias); TUI door dedups identical confirmed content via content digest until alias retained; CLI door has none (new run each invocation). Restart/recovery: repository open performs startup reconcile; explicit recovery exposed as vocabulary items (qa-recover; ReconcileOperations over all sprints/studies at serve startup paths); cleanup_uncertain marks unprovable cleanup. Error semantics unified through failedOperation taxonomy (§2.5) for app results and writeOperationError table (status/code/guidance/retryable) for HTTP; TUI renders OperationError blocks from the same taxonomy.

## 9. Immediate surface dependencies

- **durable-operation-spine** (declared): repository Accept/Alias/Claim/Heartbeat/AcknowledgeCancellation/Reconcile/Events/Snapshot/ProposeTerminal, retention/quota, fences, OwnerLeaseDuration/HeartbeatInterval/ProgressCoalesceWindow constants; appendRunEventWithRetry/proposeRunTerminalWithRetry helpers live in this package (run_control.go:345-390).
- **tui-console**: consumes OperationalUseCases/DurableOperationManager/RunUseCases; owns its digest formula and cancel ladder.
- **web-operation-hub-sse**: owns operationHub, preparationStore, security middleware, SSE projection; consumes WebOperations/DurableOperationManager/RunUseCases/OperationCleanupRecorder.

No test found that executes the *same logical operation* through two doors and compares resulting durable rows (kind/target/lifecycle parity); parity is pinned only piecewise (web kind table; CLI call-site inventory). 10. Web-only vocabulary extras (legacy kind aliases, underscore normalization, action/dry_run folding) have no counterpart filtering in TUI/CLI; the authoritative minimal kind set is the enum itself.

— End of context pack. Descriptive only; no defect claims made or implied.

## 1. Purpose

The convergence fabric behind CLI, TUI, and web: one typed operation vocabulary (`OperationKind`, 27 constants), one prepare→confirm→accept→run pipeline (`PrepareOperation`/`RunOperation` plus the optional `DurableOperationManager`), one shared runtime-backed executor (`sharedOperationRunner`), and one durable landing format (run-control rows whose `Target.Operation` stores the kind string; dedup keys stored in the `operation_aliases` table and `confirmation_digest` column). Restart/recovery: repository open performs startup reconcile; explicit recovery exposed as vocabulary items (qa-recover; ReconcileOperations over all sprints/studies at serve startup paths); cleanup_uncertain marks unprovable cleanup. 101: ## 10. Contracts (CURRENT-CONTRACT evidence)
102:

1: # Context Pack: `shared-usecase-vocabulary` — Cross-interface operation vocabulary and parity
2: 
3: Target: ultraplan-go @ 8eef70f4903b25580719960009a170945bdad9ad (frozen).
4: Planning context: ultraplan-workspace @ ab12dc38059c9bf485f9aced9075bcd7d924cac5.
5: Domain: operator-interfaces. Risk: high. Descriptive only — no defect judgments.
6: 
7: ## 1. Purpose
8: 
9: The convergence fabric behind CLI, TUI, and web: one typed operation vocabulary (`OperationKind`, 27 constants), one prepare→confirm→accept→run pipeline (`PrepareOperation`/`RunOperation` plus the optional `DurableOperationManager`), one shared runtime-backed executor (`sharedOperationRunner`), and one durable landing format (run-control rows whose `Target.Operation` stores the kind string; dedup keys stored in the `operation_aliases` table and `confirmation_digest` column). Three structurally different acceptance-digest regimes (web session+token hash, TUI content hash, CLI empty) feed the same alias column. Cancellation reasons and cancel-time target checks differ per door before converging on `RequestCancellation`. Read-only composition is split: web composes `readOnly=true`, TUI leaves it false. Durable-event replay/polling exists as three structurally similar Go loops plus an SSE/in-memory replay pair.
10: 
11: ## 2. Entrypoints and control flow
12: 
13: ### 2.1 Vocabulary core (`internal/app/operations.go`)
14: - `OperationKind` constants :74-102 (27): `validate`, `sprint-status`, `sprint-prompt`, `sprint-flow-dry-run`, `sprint-flow`, `sprint-stage-dry-run`, `sprint-stage`, `execute-status`, `execute-dry-run`, `execute-start`, `execute-resume`, `review-status`, `review-dry-run`, `review-start`, `smoke-status`, `smoke-dry-run`, `smoke-start`, `verify-dry-run`, `verify-start`, `qa-status`, `qa-dry-run`, `qa-start`, `qa-resume`, `qa-recover`, `study-start`, `study-resume`, `study-cancel`.
15: - `OperationState` :104-113: preparing/running/complete/failed/cancelled/partial.
16: - Capability interfaces: `ReadOnlyUseCases` (Dashboard, PreviewArtifact; usecases.go:24-27), `WebOperations` (Validate/PrepareOperation/RunOperation; operations.go:32-36), union `OperationalUseCases` :25-28 consumed by the TUI, optional `DurableOperationManager` :41-45 (AcceptOperation/RecordOperationEvent/FinishOperation returning `AcceptedOperation{RunID, Context, Existing, Lifecycle}`), optional `OperationCleanupRecorder` :57-59 and `OperationReconciler` :68-70 (web drain/recovery), `RunUseCases` (Runs/Run/RunEvents/CancelRun/RunHealth; run_usecases.go:29-35). `dashboardUseCases` (usecases.go:61-71) carries root, runner func, stageRuntime, reviewConcurrency, smoke/qa settings, `readOnly`, runs, durable.
17: 
18: ### 2.2 Prepare (`dashboardUseCases.PrepareOperation`, operations.go:211-358)
19: Strips caller-supplied `ExpectedFingerprint` (:215, server authority per comment :129-132), normalizes fields/lists (:523-539, lists trimmed/deduped/sorted :559-575), validates scope identifiers ([A-Za-z0-9._-], ≤128, no `/\\`, not `.`/`..`; :541-557) and QA field lockdown (project/sprint/map-owned shard only; :361-374). Review start/dry-run default Parallelism from configured review concurrency (:223-225). Per-kind Confirmation population (:227-319): runtime-free classes get warning text; QA dry-run/start/resume call `QAMap` and admit only map-owned shards; sprint-status is declared mutating ("MAY REFRESH FLOW-STATE.JSON"); smoke dry-run/start run a real `RunSmoke(DryRun:true)` preview to fill scope/prereqs/timeout source. Paths + web refresh hints (:320-331), `MutationClass` ∈ read_only/sprint_mutation/study_mutation (:332-340), `ModelSource` via stage-runtime lookup (:341-343, 603-625), prerequisites (:586-601). Canonical form = `json.Marshal(req)` with fingerprint field cleared (:577-584); fingerprint basis = canonical + `\nruntime=` ModelSource + `\nscope=` joined Scope (:351); `InputFingerprint` = sha256 over governed-input files (`governedOperationInputs` :627-661 — ultraplan.yml, project/sprint artifacts, QA adds execute/review/run-state/flow-state; studies add study.yml/yaml/run-state; missing entries skipped, symlinks rejected incl. inside dir walks, sorted walk order; :663-718).
20: 
21: ### 2.3 Run dispatch (`dashboardUseCases.RunOperation`, operations.go:376-521)
22: Clears expected, re-prepares fresh (:377-386); non-empty expected ≠ fresh fingerprint → `ErrStaleOperation` (:383-385, sentinel :209). Emits running event; in-process switch handles runtime-free kinds (validate, sprint-status, prompt, flow/stage/execute dry-runs and status, review status/dry-run, smoke status/dry-run, qa status/dry-run/recover, verify dry-run) against sprint/study/project services; all other kinds delegate to `u.runner` (nil → "runtime-backed operation is unavailable without configured composition" :513-517). Terminal complete event emitted :519.
23: 
24: ### 2.4 Shared runtime executor (`sharedOperationRunner`, operation_runner.go:18-168)
25: Single implementation wired into both serve (serve_commands.go:79) and tui (tui_commands.go:53). Maps: OperationStage/Flow → FlowStage/runSprintFlow with model override plumbing (`stageFlowRequest` :175-188); ExecuteStart/Resume → Execute(TaskID, ModelOverride, Resume); ReviewStart → Review(Concurrency/Focus/Restart/ModelOverride, progress events); SmokeStart → RunSmoke with parsed timeout (parse errors silently yield 0) and post-hoc artifact preview; VerifyStart → Verify; QAStart/QAResume → extracts writer token+fence from the durable operation context value (`qaOwnershipFromContext`, durable_operations.go:140-156) and applies `WithQAWriterFence`; StudyStart/StudyResume → runLoopService + RunLoop with parallelism/model and stats-rich progress events (`applyRuntimeObservation` operations.go:163-194 merges provider/tool observations); StudyCancel → ListStudy + `study.CancelRunLoop` (SIGINT to lock-PID lane, message reports PID :152-162). All failures route through `failedOperation`.
26: 
27: ### 2.5 Error taxonomy (`failedOperation`, operations.go:751-810)
28: context.Canceled → cancelled state; smoke errors → code/category/guidance from AsSmokeError; QA errors → `qa.<category>` with category remap (runtime unavailable/persistence→runtime, conflict→concurrency, else validation); flow-state/run-state malformed/unsupported, project/sprint RefError, or any findings → validation.reference; verification conflict or ErrStaleOperation → workflow.locked/concurrency; default internal.error. Retryable = runtime/process/timeout/concurrency categories. Cause strings pass `displaySafe` (redaction + ANSI/control strip, usecases.go:251-278).
29: 
30: ### 2.6 Acceptance digest regimes (three doors, one alias column)
31: - **Web**: prepare issues a `preparationStore` record bound to (session, CanonicalRequest, InputFingerprint) with 2-min TTL, ≤128 records, typed replay/expiry/mismatch/stale errors (security.go:368-446). Start re-prepares then consumes the token inside the hub callback; dedup key = sha256(session+"\x00"+confirmationToken) hex (security.go:448-451); `startConfirmed` checks in-memory `h.dedup` first (same-session only; stale mapping deleted), enforces draining/capacity, then calls `AcceptOperation(ctx, prepared, dedupKey)` (operations.go:150-218). Alias hit returns doc {ID=existing run id, State=accepted.Lifecycle, RefreshPath=/runs/<id>} without starting work (:193-198). If the use cases lack the durable capability (`ErrWebUnavailable`) the hub proceeds in-memory only.
32: - **TUI**: digest = hex(sha256(CanonicalRequest + "\x00" + InputFingerprint)) computed in `beginOperation` when a Confirmation exists and use cases implement the manager (internal/tui/app.go:232-254); Existing renders non-running result "matching durable operation already exists".
33: - **CLI**: `beginDurableCLICommand` wraps runtime-backed commands (flow, verify, execute, review, smoke, qa start/resume, study start/resume/task-analysis/task-synthesis) with `AcceptOperation(ctx, Confirmation{Request: request}, "")` — empty digest, so no alias row and no dedup (durable_operations.go:49-60; inventory pinned by run_control_inventory_test.go). The wrapper keeps the manager alive for the command and provides Context() and QAWriterToken(); Finish maps ctx.Err()/error → complete/cancelled/failed with 30 s timeout (durable_operations.go:62-91).
34: - **Landing**: all three converge on `repository.Accept(Acceptance{Target:{Kind:"operation", Operation:string(kind), Project, Sprint, Study, Stage, Task}, ProductStatus:"prepared", OperationAlias:digest, ConfirmationDigest:digest})` (durable_operations.go:97-115). SQLite persists target_kind/operation_kind/project_id/sprint_id/study_id/stage_id/task_id + confirmation_digest on the runs row and inserts an `operation_aliases(alias_id, run_id, alias_kind='operation')` row only when the digest is non-empty; alias conflicts surface as CodeConflict "operation alias already exists"; values bounded by MaxSafeValueBytes, control chars rejected (sqlite.go:402-455). `ResolveOperationAlias` maps alias→Snapshot (:472-484). Accept also enforces soft-quota compaction/refusal (:380-395). After accept: Claim with OwnerLeaseDuration, lifecycle-running event (failure proposes persistence_lost terminal), ownership {repository, fence} into the operation context, control goroutine started (durable_operations.go:116-137).
35: 
36: ### 2.7 Composition roots
37: - **serve** (serve_commands.go:18-99): builds a local `dashboardUseCases` with `readOnly: true` (:56-61) used for the runner; `NewWebUseCases` internally builds another dashboard copy hardcoding `readOnly: true` (web_usecases.go:420-441); both share `sharedOperationRunner`, `repositoryRunUseCases`, `newDurableOperationManager(repository, deps.runControl.owner)`; WebRunner receives ServeRunOptions (surfaces.go:10-20). Listen must be numeric loopback (:117-139).
38: - **tui** (tui_commands.go:21-61): single `dashboardUseCases` without readOnly (false), same runs/durable/runner wiring; TUIRunner handoff.
39: - **CLI runtime-backed commands**: direct service invocation guarded by beginDurableCLICommand (sprint_commands.go:237-550 six sites; study_commands.go:211-852 four sites).
40: - main wiring: app.Run builds dependencies incl. runControlState (one repository handle per workspace, startup Reconcile; run_control.go:22-95) and dispatches tui/serve (app.go:88-178).
41: 
42: ### 2.8 Web-only vocabulary projection (internal/web)
43: - Kind mapping `mapOperationRequest` (operation_handlers.go:610-742): underscores normalized to dashes; legacy aliases accepted (`validation`, `prompt-preview`, `dry-run`, `execute`, `review`, `smoke`, `verify`, `study-run-loop`; action/dry_run/resume flags fold into distinct kinds); scope rules: validate requires XOR project/study; study-* requires only study; others require project+sprint; QA option lockdown duplicated at the transport layer (:733-740) mirroring app-layer validateQAOperationRequest.
44: - Operation lifecycle document states: accepted/running/cancelling/succeeded/failed/cancelled/interrupted/cleanup_uncertain; terminal classification helper (operations.go:616-623); stable SSE names snapshot/progress/warning/finding/artifact/cancel_requested/recovery_required/terminal with unknown producer names folded to "progress" (:470-477); error envelope compatibility table (status/code/message/retryable; writeOperationError :788-828).
45: - Hub capacity/bounds (operations.go:18-32): 8 active ops, 128 preparations, 2-min TTL, 256 events & 256 KiB per op, 16 KiB max encoded event (oversize → warning substitution), 8 subscribers/op, 32 streams, 10-min terminal retention with reap, 15 s heartbeat, 30-min stream lifetime; slow subscriber dropped and counted.
46: - Drain: cancels every non-terminal owned record with reason server_shutdown, waits done; deadline overrun persists `RecordOperationCleanupUncertain` into sprint/study product storage (web_usecases.go:540-561) and projects cleanup_uncertain terminals (:479-557). `ReconcileOperations` walks all sprints (ReconcileInterruptedMutation) and studies (ReconcileInterruptedRun) (:563-591).
47: - Session ownership: status/events scoped to session; active-operations list merges hub records with a run-control page of TargetKind=operation lifecycles accepted/queued/running/cancelling (operation_handlers.go:185-204); durable fallback status/events projections require Target.Kind=="operation" (:364, 416, 452).
48: 
49: ### 2.9 Shared dashboard projections (all doors)
50: ProjectSummaries (project_usecases.go:25+), StudySummaries (study_usecases.go:74-157: planned-task preview via NewRunState with RunID "tui-preview", LoadRunState + in-memory ReconcileRunState, SummarizeRetries, lock-liveness via RunLoopActive, >2 m staleness flag, attempt history/fallback derivation), SprintSummaries (sprint_usecases.go:363-532: per-sprint Status + QAStatus + PrepareReview coverage join + nine-stage validateSprintStage loop; failure path emits bounded substitute summary with qa.invalid_state blocker; RefreshMayWrite=!readOnly disclosure fields :389-390/:455-456), QA projections (QAMap/QAStatus/QAShard/Theory/Synthesis/RunQA/ResumeQA/CancelQA/RecoverQA with displaySafe redaction throughout; theories capped at 24; shards capped at MaximumQABudgets.TotalShards; withQAConformanceReview always reads through WithoutStatusWrites() :747-758). Runs/Run/RunEvents/CancelRun/RunHealth delegate to repositoryRunUseCases, ErrWebUnavailable when absent (usecases.go:73-120).
51: 
52: ## 3. Inputs / outputs
53: 
54: Inputs: transport requests (browser JSON/form specs, TUI keystroke-built OperationRequests, CLI positional args/flags) mapped into `OperationRequest`; workspace governed files (hash inputs, dashboards); effective config (stage runtimes, DefaultParallel, smoke/QA settings); run-control DB queries; wall clock. Outputs: Confirmation DTOs (scope/warning/mutation class/fingerprints/web refresh path); OperationResults (state/subject/message/content≤32 KiB/findings/error taxonomy); OperationEvents streamed per door (in-process channels for TUI; journal + SSE for web; stderr text for CLI); durable rows (runs, operation_aliases, events, terminals, cancellation states); QA writer tokens/fences; SIGINT to foreign study run-loop PID. Browser-facing vocabulary additionally includes the frozen SSE name set, lifecycle state strings, and error codes enumerated in §2.8.
55: 
56: ## 4. Authoritative state
57: 
58: Durable authority is run-control (spine surface): runs row columns incl. target_kind, operation_kind (= OperationKind string), confirmation_digest; operation_aliases table (alias_kind='operation'); cancellation_state/reason; lifecycle/liveness/record_state/retention. This surface owns none of it directly but defines everything written there from interactive doors: Target shape built in durable_operations.go:98-102; alias/digest values from §2.6; cancellation reasons from §5. Product-side side-state touched through the vocabulary: QA cleanup-uncertainty records (RecordCleanupUncertain into sprint/study storage), flow-state.json status subrecords rewritten by Status when not readOnly. Ephemeral: web hub records/preparations/dedup map (process-lifetime, reaped), TUI model operation state.
59: 
60: ## 5. Cancellation semantics (per-door divergence)
61: 
62: All doors end in `RequestCancellation(runID, reason)` (lifecycle.go:70-134: reason required non-empty, ≤MaxSafeValueBytes, no control chars; idempotent no-op when terminal or already cancelling; CAS on last_sequence; appends cancellation event; lifecycle→cancelling; owner acknowledges within tick cadence).
63: Reason vocabularies actually sent:
64: - Browser hub path: canonicalCancelReason folds arbitrary input to {server_shutdown, timeout, recovery, else user_request} (operations.go:625-632); handlers pass literal "user_request" (operation_handlers.go:207, 390); drain passes "server_shutdown" (:490). Note spelling differs from the CLI/TUI family ("user_request" vs "user_requested").
65: - Browser durable fallback + TUI: "user_requested" (operation_handlers.go:209, 392; tui/app.go:110, 124).
66: - CancelQA use case: "read-only QA cancellation requested" (sprint_usecases.go:731), gated by membership check: snapshot Target.Project/Sprint must equal request and Target.Operation ∈ {qa-start, qa-resume}, else "QA run does not belong to the selected sprint" (:716-737).
67: - CLI `run cancel --reason`: validated against {user_requested, operator_requested, shutdown_requested, quota_exceeded}, default user_requested (run_commands.go:201-216, 394-401).
68: Target-check divergence: hub cancelOperation checks only session ownership (empty-session callers may cancel any record; used intentionally by drain, operations.go:350); durable fallback/status require Target.Kind=="operation"; CancelQA adds project/sprint/operation membership; TUI cancels ActiveRunID or the open RouteRun ID with no target-kind recheck; CLI run cancel accepts any well-formed run id. Study-cancel is not a RequestCancellation at all: it becomes OperationStudyCancel → SIGINT to the PID recorded by the study lock.
69: 
70: ## 6. Replay / polling logic (parallel implementations)

72: Same durable-replay semantics implemented independently:

247: 	case OperationQAStart, OperationQAResume:
248: 		if req.Suite == "smoke" {
249: 			c.Runtime, c.Mutates = true, true
250: 			c.Scope = []string{"one canonical smoke harness invocation", "one smoke.md and flow-state update"}
251: 			c.Warning = "RUNTIME + EXTERNAL HARNESS EVIDENCE; IMPLEMENTATION TARGET READ-ONLY"
252: 			break
253: 		}
254: 		mapped, err := u.QAMap(ctx, QARequest{Project: req.Project, Sprint: req.Sprint})
255: 		if err != nil {
256: 			return c, err
257: 		}
258: 		if req.Task != "" {
259: 			owned := false
260: 			for _, shard := range mapped.Shards {
261: 				owned = owned || shard.ID == req.Task
262: 			}
263: 			if !owned {
264: 				return c, fmt.Errorf("selected QA shard is not owned by the current map")
265: 			}
266: 		}
267: 		c.Runtime, c.Mutates = true, true
268: 		c.Scope = []string{fmt.Sprintf("deterministic map %s", mapped.MapFingerprint), fmt.Sprintf("bounded concurrency and %d total shards", mapped.TotalShards)}
269: 		if req.Task != "" {
270: 			c.Scope = append(c.Scope, "map-owned shard "+req.Task)
271: 		}
272: 		c.Warning = "RUNTIME + PRIVATE QA STATE WRITE; IMPLEMENTATION TARGET READ-ONLY"
273: 	case OperationQARecover:
274: 		c.Mutates = true
275: 		c.Scope = []string{"QA pointer, digest, interrupted ownership, flow summary, and retention reconciliation"}
276: 		c.Warning = "RUNTIME-FREE QA RECOVERY; NO CHILD WORK"
277: 	case OperationSprintStatus:
278: 		c.Mutates = true
279: 		c.Scope = []string{"all sprint stages", "execute and Conformance Review state"}
280: 		c.Warning = "RUNTIME-FREE; MAY REFRESH FLOW-STATE.JSON"
281: 	case OperationFlow:
282: 		c.Runtime = true
283: 		c.Mutates = true
284: 		c.Scope = []string{"planning stages through " + req.Stage}
285: 		c.Warning = "RUNTIME + WORKSPACE MUTATION"
286: 	case OperationStage:
287: 		c.Runtime = true
288: 		c.Mutates = true
289: 		c.Scope = []string{"selected planning stage only: " + req.Stage}
290: 		c.Warning = "RUNTIME + WORKSPACE MUTATION; PREREQUISITES MUST ALREADY BE VALID"
291: 	case OperationExecuteStart, OperationExecuteResume:
292: 		c.Runtime = true
293: 		c.Mutates = true
294: 		c.Scope = []string{"execute tasks"}
295: 		c.Warning = "RUNTIME + APPROVED TARGET MUTATION"
296: 	case OperationReviewStart:
297: 		c.Runtime = true
298: 		c.Mutates = true
299: 		c.Scope = []string{"one read-only Conformance Review worker per selected contract plus handbook", fmt.Sprintf("bounded parallelism: %d", req.Parallelism)}
300: 		if req.RestartReview {
301: 			c.Scope = append(c.Scope, "discard resumable Conformance Review checkpoints and start fresh sessions")
302: 		}
303: 		c.Warning = "RUNTIME + REVIEW ARTIFACT WRITE (TARGET READ-ONLY)"
304: 	case OperationSmokeDryRun, OperationSmokeStart:
305: 		preview, err := u.sprintService().RunSmoke(ctx, req.Project, req.Sprint, sprint.SmokeRequest{Level: req.Level, Suite: req.Suite, Test: req.Test, ForceReview: req.ForceReview, OverrideConfirmed: req.ForceReview, OverrideRationale: req.OverrideRationale, DryRun: true})
306: 		if err != nil {
307: 			return c, err
308: 		}
309: 		c.Runtime = true
310: 		c.Mutates = req.Kind == OperationSmokeStart
311: 		c.Scope = []string{fmt.Sprintf("%s %s", preview.ScopeKind, preview.Scope), preview.ScopeRationale, "prerequisites: " + strings.Join(preview.Prerequisites, ", "), "duration/cost: " + preview.DurationClass + "/" + preview.CostClass, fmt.Sprintf("timeout: %s (source: %s)", preview.EffectiveTimeout, preview.TimeoutSource), "safe command: " + preview.SafeArgv, "evidence roots: " + strings.Join(preview.EvidenceRoots, ", ")}
312: 		c.Warning = "EXTERNAL HARNESS + SMOKE ARTIFACT WRITE; RAW EVIDENCE REMAINS EXTERNAL"
313: 	case OperationVerifyDryRun, OperationVerifyStart:
314: 		c.Runtime, c.Mutates = true, req.Kind == OperationVerifyStart
315: 		c.Scope = []string{"complete execute evidence", "current Conformance Review", "Conformance Review-gated containing smoke scope"}
316: 		if req.ForceReview {
317: 			c.Scope = append(c.Scope, "DIAGNOSTIC OVERRIDE: "+req.OverrideRationale)
318: 		}
319: 		c.Warning = "ORDERED REVIEW -> SMOKE VERIFICATION; CANONICAL EVIDENCE ONLY AFTER VALIDATION"
320: 	case OperationStudyStart, OperationStudyResume:
321: 		if req.Parallelism < 1 || req.Parallelism > 64 {
322: 			return c, fmt.Errorf("parallelism must be between 1 and 64")
323: 		}
324: 		c.Runtime = true
325: 		c.Mutates = true
326: 		c.Scope = []string{fmt.Sprintf("study run-loop with %d parallel workers", req.Parallelism)}
327: 		c.Warning = "RUNTIME + STUDY STATE MUTATION"
328: 	case OperationStudyCancel:
329: 		c.Mutates = true
330: 		c.Scope = []string{"active study run-loop"}
331: 		c.Warning = "CANCEL ACTIVE RUN LOOP"
332: 	default:
333: 		return c, fmt.Errorf("unsupported operation %q", req.Kind)
334: 	}
335: 	if req.Project != "" {
336: 		if req.Sprint != "" {
337: 			c.Paths = []string{"projects/" + req.Project + "/sprints/" + req.Sprint}
338: 			c.DurableRefreshPath = "/api/v1/projects/" + req.Project + "/sprints/" + req.Sprint
339: 		} else {
340: 			c.Paths = []string{"projects/" + req.Project}
341: 			c.DurableRefreshPath = "/api/v1/projects/" + req.Project
342: 		}
343: 	} else {
344: 		c.Paths = []string{"studies/" + req.Study}
345: 		c.DurableRefreshPath = "/api/v1/studies/" + req.Study
346: 	}
347: 	if c.Mutates {
348: 		if req.Project != "" {
349: 			c.MutationClass = "sprint_mutation"
350: 		} else {
351: 			c.MutationClass = "study_mutation"
352: 		}
353: 	} else {
354: 		c.MutationClass = "read_only"
355: 	}
356: 	if c.Runtime {
357: 		c.ModelSource = operationRuntimeIdentity(req, u.stageRuntime)
358: 	}
359: 	c.Prerequisites = operationPrerequisites(req)
360: 	canonical, err := canonicalOperationRequest(req)
361: 	if err != nil {
362: 		return c, err
363: 	}
364: 	c.CanonicalRequest = canonical
365: 	c.GovernedInputs = governedOperationInputs(req)
366: 	fingerprintBasis := canonical + "\nruntime=" + c.ModelSource + "\nscope=" + strings.Join(c.Scope, "\x00")
367: 	fingerprint, err := fingerprintOperationInputs(u.root, fingerprintBasis, c.GovernedInputs)
368: 	if err != nil {
369: 		return c, err
370: 	}
371: 	c.InputFingerprint = fingerprint
372: 	c.Request.ExpectedFingerprint = fingerprint
373: 	return c, nil
374: }

376: func validateQAOperationRequest(req OperationRequest) error {
377: 	switch req.Kind {
378: 	case OperationQAStatus, OperationQADryRun, OperationQAStart, OperationQAResume, OperationQARecover:
379: 	default:
380: 		return nil
381: 	}
382: 	if req.Study != "" || req.Stage != "" || req.Model != "" || req.Level != "" || req.Test != "" || req.Timeout != "" || req.ForceReview || req.RestartReview || req.OverrideRationale != "" || len(req.ReviewFocus) > 0 || len(req.Sources) > 0 || len(req.Dimensions) > 0 || req.Parallelism != 0 {
383: 		return fmt.Errorf("QA operations accept only project, sprint, and a map-owned shard")

386: 		return fmt.Errorf("QA suite must be smoke")

388: 	if req.Suite != "" && req.Kind != OperationQAStart && req.Kind != OperationQADryRun {
389: 		return fmt.Errorf("QA suite is valid only for start or dry-run")

395: 		return fmt.Errorf("QA shard is valid only for start or resume")
396: 	}
397: 	return nil
398: }

400: func (u dashboardUseCases) RunOperation(ctx context.Context, req OperationRequest, emit func(OperationEvent)) (OperationResult, error) {
401: 	expected := req.ExpectedFingerprint
402: 	req.ExpectedFingerprint = ""
403: 	prepared, err := u.PrepareOperation(ctx, req)
404: 	if err != nil {
405: 		return failedOperation(OperationResult{Subject: operationFirstNonEmpty(req.Project+"/"+req.Sprint, req.Study)}, err)
406: 	}
407: 	if expected != "" && expected != prepared.InputFingerprint {
408: 		return failedOperation(OperationResult{Subject: prepared.Subject}, ErrStaleOperation)
409: 	}
410: 	req = prepared.Request
411: 	if emit == nil {
412: 		emit = func(OperationEvent) {}
413: 	}
414: 	emit(OperationEvent{State: OperationRunning, Stage: req.Stage, Message: "operation started"})
415: 	if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
416: 		return OperationResult{State: OperationCancelled}, err
417: 	}
418: 	ss := u.sprintService()
419: 	result := OperationResult{State: OperationComplete, Subject: operationFirstNonEmpty(req.Project+"/"+req.Sprint, req.Study)}
420: 	stage := sprint.PlanningStage(req.Stage)
421: 	switch req.Kind {
422: 	case OperationValidate:
423: 		validationReq := ValidationRequest{Project: req.Project, Sprint: req.Sprint, Study: req.Study, Stage: req.Stage}
424: 		switch {
425: 		case req.Study != "":
426: 			validationReq.Subject = ValidationStudy
427: 		case req.Sprint != "":
428: 			validationReq.Subject = ValidationSprint
429: 		default:
430: 			validationReq.Subject = ValidationProject
431: 		}
432: 		validation, err := u.Validate(ctx, validationReq)
433: 		if err != nil {
434: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
435: 		}
436: 		result.Message = validation.Status
437: 		result.Findings = append(result.Findings, validation.Findings...)
438: 	case OperationSprintStatus:
439: 		r, err := ss.Status(req.Project, req.Sprint)
440: 		if err != nil {
441: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
442: 		}
443: 		result.Message = summarizeSprintStatus(r)
444: 	case OperationPrompt:
445: 		p, err := promptSprintStage(ss, req.Project, req.Sprint, stage)
446: 		if err != nil {
447: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
448: 		}
449: 		result.Content, result.Truncated = boundContent(p.Prompt)
450: 	case OperationFlowDryRun:
451: 		r, err := runSprintFlow(ctx, ss, req.Project, req.Sprint, sprint.FlowRequest{To: stage, DryRun: true})
452: 		if err != nil {
453: 			result = operationWithSprintFindings(result, r.Findings)
454: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
455: 		}
456: 		result.Content, result.Truncated = boundContent(r.Message)
457: 		result.Message = fmt.Sprintf("flow to %s dry run", stage)
458: 	case OperationStageDryRun:
459: 		r, err := ss.FlowStage(ctx, req.Project, req.Sprint, sprint.FlowRequest{To: stage, DryRun: true})
460: 		if err != nil {
461: 			result = operationWithSprintFindings(result, r.Findings)
462: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
463: 		}
464: 		result.Content, result.Truncated = boundContent(r.Message)
465: 		result.Message = fmt.Sprintf("single-stage %s dry run", stage)
466: 	case OperationExecuteDryRun:
467: 		r, err := ss.Execute(ctx, req.Project, req.Sprint, sprint.ExecuteRequest{DryRun: true, TaskID: req.Task})
468: 		if err != nil {
469: 			result = operationWithSprintFindings(result, r.Findings)
470: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
471: 		}
472: 		result.Content, result.Truncated = boundContent(r.Prompt)
473: 		result.Message = r.Message
474: 	case OperationExecuteStatus:
475: 		r, err := ss.Status(req.Project, req.Sprint)
476: 		if err != nil {
477: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
478: 		}
479: 		execute := summarizeExecute(r.ExecuteState)
480: 		if !execute.Available {
481: 			result.Message = execute.Message
482: 		} else {
483: 			result.Message = fmt.Sprintf("%d total: %d pending, %d running, %d complete, %d failed, %d cancelled", execute.Total, execute.Pending, execute.Running, execute.Complete, execute.Failed, execute.Cancelled)
484: 		}
485: 	case OperationReviewDryRun:
486: 		r, err := ss.Review(ctx, req.Project, req.Sprint, sprint.ReviewRequest{DryRun: true, Concurrency: req.Parallelism})
487: 		if err != nil {
488: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
489: 		}
490: 		result.Content, result.Truncated = boundContent(r.Prompt)
491: 		result.Message = r.Message
492: 	case OperationReviewStatus:
493: 		r, err := ss.Status(req.Project, req.Sprint)
494: 		if err != nil {
495: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
496: 		}
497: 		result.Message = fmt.Sprintf("%s verdict=%s fresh=%t next=%s", r.Verification.Review.ExecutionStatus, r.Verification.Review.Verdict, r.Verification.Review.Fresh, r.Verification.Review.NextAction)
498: 	case OperationSmokeStatus:
499: 		r, err := ss.VerificationStatus(req.Project, req.Sprint)
500: 		if err != nil {
501: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
502: 		}
503: 		result.Message = fmt.Sprintf("%s verdict=%s fresh=%t run=%s issues=%d assessment=%s next=%s", r.Smoke.ExecutionStatus, r.Smoke.Verdict, r.Smoke.Fresh, r.Smoke.RunID, len(r.Smoke.Issues), r.Assessment, r.NextAction)
504: 	case OperationSmokeDryRun:
505: 		r, err := ss.RunSmoke(ctx, req.Project, req.Sprint, sprint.SmokeRequest{Level: req.Level, Suite: req.Suite, Test: req.Test, ForceReview: req.ForceReview, OverrideConfirmed: req.ForceReview, OverrideRationale: req.OverrideRationale, DryRun: true})
506: 		if err != nil {
507: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
508: 		}
509: 		result.Message = fmt.Sprintf("%s %s: %s", r.ScopeKind, r.Scope, r.ScopeRationale)
510: 		result.Content, result.Truncated = boundContent(sprint.RenderSmoke(r))
511: 	case OperationQAStatus:
512: 		qa, err := u.QAStatus(ctx, QARequest{Project: req.Project, Sprint: req.Sprint})
513: 		if err != nil {
514: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
515: 		}
516: 		result.Message = fmt.Sprintf("phase=%s fresh=%t shards=%d/%d next=%s", qa.Phase, qa.Fresh, qa.CompletedShards, qa.TotalShards, qa.NextAction)
517: 	case OperationQADryRun:
518: 		if req.Suite == "smoke" {
519: 			smoke, err := ss.RunSmoke(ctx, req.Project, req.Sprint, sprint.SmokeRequest{DryRun: true})
520: 			if err != nil {
521: 				return failedOperation(result, err)
522: 			}
523: 			result.Message = fmt.Sprintf("smoke suite ready: %s %s", smoke.ScopeKind, smoke.Scope)
524: 			result.Content, result.Truncated = boundContent(sprint.RenderSmoke(smoke))
525: 			break
526: 		}
527: 		qa, err := u.QAMap(ctx, QARequest{Project: req.Project, Sprint: req.Sprint})
528: 		if err != nil {
529: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
530: 		}
531: 		data, _ := json.MarshalIndent(qa, "", "  ")
532: 		result.Content, result.Truncated = boundContent(string(data))
533: 		result.Message = "read-only QA map ready"
534: 	case OperationQARecover:
535: 		qa, err := u.RecoverQA(ctx, QARequest{Project: req.Project, Sprint: req.Sprint})
536: 		if err != nil {
537: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
538: 		}
539: 		result.Message = fmt.Sprintf("phase=%s next=%s", qa.Phase, qa.NextAction)
540: 	case OperationVerifyDryRun:
541: 		r, err := ss.Verify(ctx, req.Project, req.Sprint, sprint.VerifyRequest{To: sprint.PlanningStage(req.Stage), DryRun: true, Review: sprint.ReviewRequest{DryRun: true, Focus: req.ReviewFocus, Restart: req.RestartReview}, Smoke: sprint.SmokeRequest{Level: req.Level, Suite: req.Suite, Test: req.Test, ForceReview: req.ForceReview, OverrideConfirmed: req.ForceReview, OverrideRationale: req.OverrideRationale, DryRun: true}})
542: 		if err != nil {
543: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
544: 		}
545: 		result.Message = fmt.Sprintf("assessment=%s next=%s", r.Verification.Assessment, r.Verification.NextAction)
546: 	default:
547: 		if u.runner == nil {
548: 			return failedOperation(result, fmt.Errorf("runtime-backed operation is unavailable without configured composition"))
549: 		}
550: 		return u.runner(ctx, req, emit)
551: 	}
552: 	emit(OperationEvent{State: OperationComplete, Stage: req.Stage, Message: operationFirstNonEmpty(result.Message, "operation complete")})
553: 	return result, nil
554: }

574: func validateOperationScope(req OperationRequest) error {
575: 	for name, value := range map[string]string{"project": req.Project, "sprint": req.Sprint, "study": req.Study} {
576: 		if value == "" {
577: 			continue
578: 		}
579: 		if value == "." || value == ".." || len(value) > 128 || strings.ContainsAny(value, `/\\`) {
580: 			return fmt.Errorf("invalid operation %s reference", name)
581: 		}
582: 		for _, r := range value {
583: 			if (r >= 'a' && r <= 'z') || (r >= 'A' && r <= 'Z') || (r >= '0' && r <= '9') || r == '.' || r == '_' || r == '-' {
584: 				continue
585: 			}
586: 			return fmt.Errorf("invalid operation %s reference", name)
587: 		}
588: 	}
589: 	return nil
590: }

592: func normalizedStrings(values []string) []string {
593: 	seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(values))
594: 	out := make([]string, 0, len(values))
595: 	for _, value := range values {
596: 		value = strings.TrimSpace(value)
597: 		if value == "" {
598: 			continue
599: 		}
600: 		if _, ok := seen[value]; ok {
601: 			continue
602: 		}
603: 		seen[value] = struct{}{}
604: 		out = append(out, value)
605: 	}
606: 	sort.Strings(out)
607: 	return out
608: }

636: func operationRuntimeIdentity(req OperationRequest, stages map[sprint.PlanningStage]sprint.StageRuntime) string {
637: 	if req.Model != "" {
638: 		return "requested model " + req.Model
639: 	}
640: 	stage := sprint.PlanningStage(req.Stage)
641: 	switch req.Kind {
642: 	case OperationExecuteStart, OperationExecuteResume:
643: 		stage = sprint.StageExecute
644: 	case OperationReviewStart:
645: 		stage = sprint.StageReview
646: 	case OperationSmokeStart, OperationVerifyStart:
647: 		stage = sprint.StageSmoke
648: 	case OperationQAStart, OperationQAResume:
649: 		if req.Suite == "smoke" {
650: 			return "configured smoke author and harness"
651: 		}
652: 		return "configured QA runtime"
653: 	}
654: 	if runtime, ok := stages[stage]; ok && (runtime.Model != "" || runtime.Variant != "") {
655: 		return strings.TrimSpace(runtime.Model + " variant=" + runtime.Variant)
656: 	}
657: 	if req.Kind == OperationSmokeStart {
658: 		return "configured smoke author and harness"
659: 	}
660: 	return "effective workspace runtime configuration"
661: }

699: func fingerprintOperationInputs(root, canonical string, inputs []string) (string, error) {
700: 	hash := sha256.New()
701: 	_, _ = hash.Write([]byte(canonical))
702: 	for _, rel := range inputs {
703: 		path := filepath.Join(root, filepath.FromSlash(rel))
704: 		info, err := os.Lstat(path)
705: 		if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
706: 			continue
707: 		}
708: 		if err != nil {
709: 			return "", fmt.Errorf("inspect governed input %s: %w", rel, err)
710: 		}
711: 		if info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
712: 			return "", fmt.Errorf("governed input %s must not be a symbolic link", rel)
713: 		}
714: 		if info.IsDir() {
715: 			var files []string
716: 			if err := filepath.WalkDir(path, func(item string, entry fs.DirEntry, walkErr error) error {
717: 				if walkErr != nil {
718: 					return walkErr
719: 				}
720: 				if entry.Type()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
721: 					return fmt.Errorf("governed input %s must not contain symbolic links", rel)
722: 				}
723: 				if !entry.IsDir() {
724: 					files = append(files, item)
725: 				}
726: 				return nil
727: 			}); err != nil {
728: 				return "", fmt.Errorf("scan governed input %s: %w", rel, err)
729: 			}
730: 			sort.Strings(files)
731: 			for _, item := range files {
732: 				itemRel, _ := filepath.Rel(root, item)
733: 				if err := hashOperationFile(hash, item, filepath.ToSlash(itemRel)); err != nil {
734: 					return "", err
735: 				}
736: 			}
737: 			continue
738: 		}
739: 		if err := hashOperationFile(hash, path, rel); err != nil {
740: 			return "", err
741: 		}
742: 	}
743: 	return "sha256:" + hex.EncodeToString(hash.Sum(nil)), nil
744: }

746: func hashOperationFile(hash interface{ Write([]byte) (int, error) }, path, rel string) error {
747: 	data, err := os.ReadFile(path)

749: 		return fmt.Errorf("read governed input %s: %w", rel, err)
750: 	}
751: 	_, _ = hash.Write([]byte("\x00" + rel + "\x00"))
752: 	_, _ = hash.Write(data)
753: 	return nil

762: 	if execute.Available {

764: 	} else {

769: 	} else {

790: 	} else {

794: 	code, category, guidance := "internal.error", "internal", "Inspect durable state and retry after correcting the reported cause."
795: 	if smokeErr, ok := sprint.AsSmokeError(err); ok {
796: 		code, category, guidance = smokeErr.Code, smokeErr.Category, smokeErr.Guidance

798: 		r.Error = &OperationError{Code: code, Category: category, Operation: "smoke", Component: "sprint", Message: r.Message, Cause: cause, Guidance: guidance, Retryable: category == "process" || category == "timeout"}
799: 		return r, err

801: 	if qaErr, ok := sprint.AsQAError(err); ok {
802: 		category = string(qaErr.Category)
803: 		code = "qa." + category
804: 		guidance = qaErr.Recovery
805: 		switch qaErr.Category {
806: 		case sprint.QAErrorRuntimeUnavailable, sprint.QAErrorPersistenceFailure:
807: 			category = "runtime"
808: 		case sprint.QAErrorConflict:
809: 			category = "concurrency"

812: 		}
813: 		r.Message = operationFailureMessage(category)
814: 		r.Error = &OperationError{Code: code, Category: category, Operation: "qa", Component: "sprint", Message: r.Message, Cause: cause, Guidance: guidance, Retryable: qaErr.Category == sprint.QAErrorRuntimeUnavailable || qaErr.Category == sprint.QAErrorConflict}
815: 		return r, err
816: 	}

818: 	var sprintRef sprint.RefError

823: 		errors.Is(err, sprint.ErrExecuteRunStateMissing), errors.Is(err, sprint.ErrExecuteRunStateMalformed), errors.Is(err, sprint.ErrExecuteRunStateUnsupported),
824: 		errors.As(err, &projectRef), errors.As(err, &sprintRef), len(r.Findings) > 0:

827: 		code, category, guidance = "workflow.locked", "concurrency", "Inspect the active or stale study lock before retrying."
828: 	}
829: 	r.Message = operationFailureMessage(category)
830: 	r.Error = &OperationError{Code: code, Category: category, Operation: "workflow.operation", Component: "app", Message: r.Message, Cause: cause, Guidance: guidance, Retryable: category == "runtime" || category == "concurrency"}
831: 	return r, err

911: 	if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
912: 		return ValidationOperationResult{}, err
913: 	}
914: 	result := ValidationOperationResult{Operation: "validate", Status: "valid"}
915: 	switch req.Subject {

922: 		result.Subject = ref
923: 		result.Status = string(validation.Status)
924: 		for _, finding := range validation.Findings {
925: 			result.Findings = append(result.Findings, projectFinding(finding))
926: 		}
927: 	case ValidationStudy:
928: 		ref := strings.TrimSpace(req.Study)
929: 		validation, err := study.NewService(u.root).ValidateStudy(ref)
930: 		if err != nil {

933: 		result.Subject = ref
934: 		result.Status = string(validation.Status)
935: 		for _, check := range validation.Checks {

937: 				result.Findings = append(result.Findings, studyFinding(check))
938: 			}
939: 		}
940: 		for _, report := range validation.Reports {

950: 		if err != nil {
951: 			return result, mapSprintError("sprint.validate", err)
952: 		}
953: 		result.Subject = strings.TrimSpace(req.Project) + "/" + strings.TrimSpace(req.Sprint) + "/" + string(stage)
954: 		if !validation.Valid() {
955: 			result.Status = "invalid"
956: 		}

958: 			result.Findings = append(result.Findings, sprintFinding(finding))
959: 		}
960: 	default:
961: 		return result, fmt.Errorf("validate: unsupported subject %q", req.Subject)
962: 	}
963: 	sort.SliceStable(result.Findings, func(i, j int) bool {
964: 		a, b := result.Findings[i], result.Findings[j]
965: 		if a.Path != b.Path {
966: 			return a.Path < b.Path
967: 		}
968: 		if a.Section != b.Section {
969: 			return a.Section < b.Section
970: 		}
971: 		return a.Problem < b.Problem
972: 	})
973: 	return result, nil

249: 			c.Runtime, c.Mutates = true, true
250: 			c.Scope = []string{"one canonical smoke harness invocation", "one smoke.md and flow-state update"}
251: 			c.Warning = "RUNTIME + EXTERNAL HARNESS EVIDENCE; IMPLEMENTATION TARGET READ-ONLY"
252: 			break
253: 		}
254: 		mapped, err := u.QAMap(ctx, QARequest{Project: req.Project, Sprint: req.Sprint})
255: 		if err != nil {
256: 			return c, err
257: 		}
258: 		if req.Task != "" {
259: 			owned := false
260: 			for _, shard := range mapped.Shards {
261: 				owned = owned || shard.ID == req.Task
262: 			}
263: 			if !owned {
264: 				return c, fmt.Errorf("selected QA shard is not owned by the current map")
265: 			}
266: 		}
267: 		c.Runtime, c.Mutates = true, true
268: 		c.Scope = []string{fmt.Sprintf("deterministic map %s", mapped.MapFingerprint), fmt.Sprintf("bounded concurrency and %d total shards", mapped.TotalShards)}
269: 		if req.Task != "" {
270: 			c.Scope = append(c.Scope, "map-owned shard "+req.Task)
271: 		}
272: 		c.Warning = "RUNTIME + PRIVATE QA STATE WRITE; IMPLEMENTATION TARGET READ-ONLY"
273: 	case OperationQARecover:
274: 		c.Mutates = true
275: 		c.Scope = []string{"QA pointer, digest, interrupted ownership, flow summary, and retention reconciliation"}
276: 		c.Warning = "RUNTIME-FREE QA RECOVERY; NO CHILD WORK"
277: 	case OperationSprintStatus:
278: 		c.Mutates = true
279: 		c.Scope = []string{"all sprint stages", "execute and Conformance Review state"}
280: 		c.Warning = "RUNTIME-FREE; MAY REFRESH FLOW-STATE.JSON"
281: 	case OperationFlow:
282: 		c.Runtime = true
283: 		c.Mutates = true
284: 		c.Scope = []string{"planning stages through " + req.Stage}
285: 		c.Warning = "RUNTIME + WORKSPACE MUTATION"
286: 	case OperationStage:
287: 		c.Runtime = true
288: 		c.Mutates = true
289: 		c.Scope = []string{"selected planning stage only: " + req.Stage}
290: 		c.Warning = "RUNTIME + WORKSPACE MUTATION; PREREQUISITES MUST ALREADY BE VALID"
291: 	case OperationExecuteStart, OperationExecuteResume:
292: 		c.Runtime = true
293: 		c.Mutates = true
294: 		c.Scope = []string{"execute tasks"}
295: 		c.Warning = "RUNTIME + APPROVED TARGET MUTATION"
296: 	case OperationReviewStart:
297: 		c.Runtime = true
298: 		c.Mutates = true
299: 		c.Scope = []string{"one read-only Conformance Review worker per selected contract plus handbook", fmt.Sprintf("bounded parallelism: %d", req.Parallelism)}
300: 		if req.RestartReview {
301: 			c.Scope = append(c.Scope, "discard resumable Conformance Review checkpoints and start fresh sessions")
302: 		}
303: 		c.Warning = "RUNTIME + REVIEW ARTIFACT WRITE (TARGET READ-ONLY)"
304: 	case OperationSmokeDryRun, OperationSmokeStart:
305: 		preview, err := u.sprintService().RunSmoke(ctx, req.Project, req.Sprint, sprint.SmokeRequest{Level: req.Level, Suite: req.Suite, Test: req.Test, ForceReview: req.ForceReview, OverrideConfirmed: req.ForceReview, OverrideRationale: req.OverrideRationale, DryRun: true})
306: 		if err != nil {
307: 			return c, err
308: 		}
309: 		c.Runtime = true
310: 		c.Mutates = req.Kind == OperationSmokeStart
311: 		c.Scope = []string{fmt.Sprintf("%s %s", preview.ScopeKind, preview.Scope), preview.ScopeRationale, "prerequisites: " + strings.Join(preview.Prerequisites, ", "), "duration/cost: " + preview.DurationClass + "/" + preview.CostClass, fmt.Sprintf("timeout: %s (source: %s)", preview.EffectiveTimeout, preview.TimeoutSource), "safe command: " + preview.SafeArgv, "evidence roots: " + strings.Join(preview.EvidenceRoots, ", ")}
312: 		c.Warning = "EXTERNAL HARNESS + SMOKE ARTIFACT WRITE; RAW EVIDENCE REMAINS EXTERNAL"
313: 	case OperationVerifyDryRun, OperationVerifyStart:
314: 		c.Runtime, c.Mutates = true, req.Kind == OperationVerifyStart
315: 		c.Scope = []string{"complete execute evidence", "current Conformance Review", "Conformance Review-gated containing smoke scope"}
316: 		if req.ForceReview {
317: 			c.Scope = append(c.Scope, "DIAGNOSTIC OVERRIDE: "+req.OverrideRationale)
318: 		}
319: 		c.Warning = "ORDERED REVIEW -> SMOKE VERIFICATION; CANONICAL EVIDENCE ONLY AFTER VALIDATION"
320: 	case OperationStudyStart, OperationStudyResume:
321: 		if req.Parallelism < 1 || req.Parallelism > 64 {
322: 			return c, fmt.Errorf("parallelism must be between 1 and 64")
323: 		}
324: 		c.Runtime = true
325: 		c.Mutates = true
326: 		c.Scope = []string{fmt.Sprintf("study run-loop with %d parallel workers", req.Parallelism)}
327: 		c.Warning = "RUNTIME + STUDY STATE MUTATION"
328: 	case OperationStudyCancel:
329: 		c.Mutates = true
330: 		c.Scope = []string{"active study run-loop"}
331: 		c.Warning = "CANCEL ACTIVE RUN LOOP"
332: 	default:
333: 		return c, fmt.Errorf("unsupported operation %q", req.Kind)
334: 	}
335: 	if req.Project != "" {
336: 		if req.Sprint != "" {
337: 			c.Paths = []string{"projects/" + req.Project + "/sprints/" + req.Sprint}
338: 			c.DurableRefreshPath = "/api/v1/projects/" + req.Project + "/sprints/" + req.Sprint
339: 		} else {
340: 			c.Paths = []string{"projects/" + req.Project}
341: 			c.DurableRefreshPath = "/api/v1/projects/" + req.Project
342: 		}
343: 	} else {
344: 		c.Paths = []string{"studies/" + req.Study}
345: 		c.DurableRefreshPath = "/api/v1/studies/" + req.Study
346: 	}
347: 	if c.Mutates {
348: 		if req.Project != "" {
349: 			c.MutationClass = "sprint_mutation"
350: 		} else {
351: 			c.MutationClass = "study_mutation"
352: 		}
353: 	} else {
354: 		c.MutationClass = "read_only"
355: 	}
356: 	if c.Runtime {
357: 		c.ModelSource = operationRuntimeIdentity(req, u.stageRuntime)
358: 	}
359: 	c.Prerequisites = operationPrerequisites(req)
360: 	canonical, err := canonicalOperationRequest(req)
361: 	if err != nil {
362: 		return c, err
363: 	}
364: 	c.CanonicalRequest = canonical
365: 	c.GovernedInputs = governedOperationInputs(req)
366: 	fingerprintBasis := canonical + "\nruntime=" + c.ModelSource + "\nscope=" + strings.Join(c.Scope, "\x00")
367: 	fingerprint, err := fingerprintOperationInputs(u.root, fingerprintBasis, c.GovernedInputs)
368: 	if err != nil {
369: 		return c, err
370: 	}
371: 	c.InputFingerprint = fingerprint
372: 	c.Request.ExpectedFingerprint = fingerprint
373: 	return c, nil
374: }

376: func validateQAOperationRequest(req OperationRequest) error {
377: 	switch req.Kind {
378: 	case OperationQAStatus, OperationQADryRun, OperationQAStart, OperationQAResume, OperationQARecover:
379: 	default:
380: 		return nil
381: 	}
382: 	if req.Study != "" || req.Stage != "" || req.Model != "" || req.Level != "" || req.Test != "" || req.Timeout != "" || req.ForceReview || req.RestartReview || req.OverrideRationale != "" || len(req.ReviewFocus) > 0 || len(req.Sources) > 0 || len(req.Dimensions) > 0 || req.Parallelism != 0 {
383: 		return fmt.Errorf("QA operations accept only project, sprint, and a map-owned shard")
384: 	}
385: 	if req.Suite != "" && req.Suite != "smoke" {
386: 		return fmt.Errorf("QA suite must be smoke")
387: 	}
388: 	if req.Suite != "" && req.Kind != OperationQAStart && req.Kind != OperationQADryRun {
389: 		return fmt.Errorf("QA suite is valid only for start or dry-run")
390: 	}
391: 	if req.Suite != "" && req.Task != "" {
392: 		return fmt.Errorf("QA suite and shard focus are mutually exclusive")
393: 	}
394: 	if req.Task != "" && req.Kind != OperationQAStart && req.Kind != OperationQAResume {
395: 		return fmt.Errorf("QA shard is valid only for start or resume")
396: 	}
397: 	return nil
398: }

400: func (u dashboardUseCases) RunOperation(ctx context.Context, req OperationRequest, emit func(OperationEvent)) (OperationResult, error) {
401: 	expected := req.ExpectedFingerprint
402: 	req.ExpectedFingerprint = ""
403: 	prepared, err := u.PrepareOperation(ctx, req)
404: 	if err != nil {
405: 		return failedOperation(OperationResult{Subject: operationFirstNonEmpty(req.Project+"/"+req.Sprint, req.Study)}, err)
406: 	}
407: 	if expected != "" && expected != prepared.InputFingerprint {
408: 		return failedOperation(OperationResult{Subject: prepared.Subject}, ErrStaleOperation)
409: 	}
410: 	req = prepared.Request
411: 	if emit == nil {
412: 		emit = func(OperationEvent) {}
413: 	}
414: 	emit(OperationEvent{State: OperationRunning, Stage: req.Stage, Message: "operation started"})
415: 	if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
416: 		return OperationResult{State: OperationCancelled}, err
417: 	}
418: 	ss := u.sprintService()
419: 	result := OperationResult{State: OperationComplete, Subject: operationFirstNonEmpty(req.Project+"/"+req.Sprint, req.Study)}
420: 	stage := sprint.PlanningStage(req.Stage)
421: 	switch req.Kind {
422: 	case OperationValidate:
423: 		validationReq := ValidationRequest{Project: req.Project, Sprint: req.Sprint, Study: req.Study, Stage: req.Stage}
424: 		switch {
425: 		case req.Study != "":
426: 			validationReq.Subject = ValidationStudy
427: 		case req.Sprint != "":
428: 			validationReq.Subject = ValidationSprint
429: 		default:
430: 			validationReq.Subject = ValidationProject
431: 		}
432: 		validation, err := u.Validate(ctx, validationReq)
433: 		if err != nil {
434: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
435: 		}
436: 		result.Message = validation.Status
437: 		result.Findings = append(result.Findings, validation.Findings...)
438: 	case OperationSprintStatus:
439: 		r, err := ss.Status(req.Project, req.Sprint)
440: 		if err != nil {
441: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
442: 		}
443: 		result.Message = summarizeSprintStatus(r)
444: 	case OperationPrompt:
445: 		p, err := promptSprintStage(ss, req.Project, req.Sprint, stage)
446: 		if err != nil {
447: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
448: 		}
449: 		result.Content, result.Truncated = boundContent(p.Prompt)
450: 	case OperationFlowDryRun:
451: 		r, err := runSprintFlow(ctx, ss, req.Project, req.Sprint, sprint.FlowRequest{To: stage, DryRun: true})
452: 		if err != nil {
453: 			result = operationWithSprintFindings(result, r.Findings)
454: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
455: 		}
456: 		result.Content, result.Truncated = boundContent(r.Message)
457: 		result.Message = fmt.Sprintf("flow to %s dry run", stage)
458: 	case OperationStageDryRun:
459: 		r, err := ss.FlowStage(ctx, req.Project, req.Sprint, sprint.FlowRequest{To: stage, DryRun: true})
460: 		if err != nil {
461: 			result = operationWithSprintFindings(result, r.Findings)
462: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
463: 		}
464: 		result.Content, result.Truncated = boundContent(r.Message)
465: 		result.Message = fmt.Sprintf("single-stage %s dry run", stage)
466: 	case OperationExecuteDryRun:
467: 		r, err := ss.Execute(ctx, req.Project, req.Sprint, sprint.ExecuteRequest{DryRun: true, TaskID: req.Task})
468: 		if err != nil {
469: 			result = operationWithSprintFindings(result, r.Findings)
470: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
471: 		}
472: 		result.Content, result.Truncated = boundContent(r.Prompt)
473: 		result.Message = r.Message
474: 	case OperationExecuteStatus:
475: 		r, err := ss.Status(req.Project, req.Sprint)
476: 		if err != nil {
477: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
478: 		}
479: 		execute := summarizeExecute(r.ExecuteState)
480: 		if !execute.Available {
481: 			result.Message = execute.Message
482: 		} else {
483: 			result.Message = fmt.Sprintf("%d total: %d pending, %d running, %d complete, %d failed, %d cancelled", execute.Total, execute.Pending, execute.Running, execute.Complete, execute.Failed, execute.Cancelled)
484: 		}
485: 	case OperationReviewDryRun:
486: 		r, err := ss.Review(ctx, req.Project, req.Sprint, sprint.ReviewRequest{DryRun: true, Concurrency: req.Parallelism})
487: 		if err != nil {
488: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
489: 		}
490: 		result.Content, result.Truncated = boundContent(r.Prompt)
491: 		result.Message = r.Message
492: 	case OperationReviewStatus:
493: 		r, err := ss.Status(req.Project, req.Sprint)
494: 		if err != nil {
495: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
496: 		}
497: 		result.Message = fmt.Sprintf("%s verdict=%s fresh=%t next=%s", r.Verification.Review.ExecutionStatus, r.Verification.Review.Verdict, r.Verification.Review.Fresh, r.Verification.Review.NextAction)
498: 	case OperationSmokeStatus:
499: 		r, err := ss.VerificationStatus(req.Project, req.Sprint)
500: 		if err != nil {
501: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
502: 		}
503: 		result.Message = fmt.Sprintf("%s verdict=%s fresh=%t run=%s issues=%d assessment=%s next=%s", r.Smoke.ExecutionStatus, r.Smoke.Verdict, r.Smoke.Fresh, r.Smoke.RunID, len(r.Smoke.Issues), r.Assessment, r.NextAction)
504: 	case OperationSmokeDryRun:
505: 		r, err := ss.RunSmoke(ctx, req.Project, req.Sprint, sprint.SmokeRequest{Level: req.Level, Suite: req.Suite, Test: req.Test, ForceReview: req.ForceReview, OverrideConfirmed: req.ForceReview, OverrideRationale: req.OverrideRationale, DryRun: true})
506: 		if err != nil {
507: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
508: 		}
509: 		result.Message = fmt.Sprintf("%s %s: %s", r.ScopeKind, r.Scope, r.ScopeRationale)
510: 		result.Content, result.Truncated = boundContent(sprint.RenderSmoke(r))
511: 	case OperationQAStatus:
512: 		qa, err := u.QAStatus(ctx, QARequest{Project: req.Project, Sprint: req.Sprint})
513: 		if err != nil {
514: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
515: 		}
516: 		result.Message = fmt.Sprintf("phase=%s fresh=%t shards=%d/%d next=%s", qa.Phase, qa.Fresh, qa.CompletedShards, qa.TotalShards, qa.NextAction)
517: 	case OperationQADryRun:
518: 		if req.Suite == "smoke" {
519: 			smoke, err := ss.RunSmoke(ctx, req.Project, req.Sprint, sprint.SmokeRequest{DryRun: true})
520: 			if err != nil {
521: 				return failedOperation(result, err)
522: 			}
523: 			result.Message = fmt.Sprintf("smoke suite ready: %s %s", smoke.ScopeKind, smoke.Scope)
524: 			result.Content, result.Truncated = boundContent(sprint.RenderSmoke(smoke))
525: 			break
526: 		}
527: 		qa, err := u.QAMap(ctx, QARequest{Project: req.Project, Sprint: req.Sprint})
528: 		if err != nil {
529: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
530: 		}
531: 		data, _ := json.MarshalIndent(qa, "", "  ")
532: 		result.Content, result.Truncated = boundContent(string(data))
533: 		result.Message = "read-only QA map ready"
534: 	case OperationQARecover:
535: 		qa, err := u.RecoverQA(ctx, QARequest{Project: req.Project, Sprint: req.Sprint})
536: 		if err != nil {
537: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
538: 		}
539: 		result.Message = fmt.Sprintf("phase=%s next=%s", qa.Phase, qa.NextAction)
540: 	case OperationVerifyDryRun:
541: 		r, err := ss.Verify(ctx, req.Project, req.Sprint, sprint.VerifyRequest{To: sprint.PlanningStage(req.Stage), DryRun: true, Review: sprint.ReviewRequest{DryRun: true, Focus: req.ReviewFocus, Restart: req.RestartReview}, Smoke: sprint.SmokeRequest{Level: req.Level, Suite: req.Suite, Test: req.Test, ForceReview: req.ForceReview, OverrideConfirmed: req.ForceReview, OverrideRationale: req.OverrideRationale, DryRun: true}})
542: 		if err != nil {
543: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
544: 		}
545: 		result.Message = fmt.Sprintf("assessment=%s next=%s", r.Verification.Assessment, r.Verification.NextAction)
546: 	default:
547: 		if u.runner == nil {
548: 			return failedOperation(result, fmt.Errorf("runtime-backed operation is unavailable without configured composition"))
549: 		}
550: 		return u.runner(ctx, req, emit)
551: 	}
552: 	emit(OperationEvent{State: OperationComplete, Stage: req.Stage, Message: operationFirstNonEmpty(result.Message, "operation complete")})
553: 	return result, nil
554: }

558: 	req.Sprint = strings.TrimSpace(req.Sprint)

565: 	req.Test = strings.TrimSpace(req.Test)

574: func validateOperationScope(req OperationRequest) error {
575: 	for name, value := range map[string]string{"project": req.Project, "sprint": req.Sprint, "study": req.Study} {
576: 		if value == "" {
577: 			continue
578: 		}
579: 		if value == "." || value == ".." || len(value) > 128 || strings.ContainsAny(value, `/\\`) {
580: 			return fmt.Errorf("invalid operation %s reference", name)
581: 		}
582: 		for _, r := range value {
583: 			if (r >= 'a' && r <= 'z') || (r >= 'A' && r <= 'Z') || (r >= '0' && r <= '9') || r == '.' || r == '_' || r == '-' {
584: 				continue
585: 			}
586: 			return fmt.Errorf("invalid operation %s reference", name)
587: 		}
588: 	}
589: 	return nil
590: }

592: func normalizedStrings(values []string) []string {
593: 	seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(values))
594: 	out := make([]string, 0, len(values))
595: 	for _, value := range values {
596: 		value = strings.TrimSpace(value)
597: 		if value == "" {
598: 			continue
599: 		}
600: 		if _, ok := seen[value]; ok {
601: 			continue
602: 		}
603: 		seen[value] = struct{}{}
604: 		out = append(out, value)
605: 	}
606: 	sort.Strings(out)
607: 	return out
608: }
